reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Arsenal FC are favoured at 70%, against 13% for Borussia Dortmund and 17% for the draw. Arsenal FC carry 171 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: Arsenal FC 2.2 points per game, Borussia Dortmund 1.8. They average 2.7 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.89 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 74%. Across their last five, Arsenal FC and Borussia Dortmund have scored 1.6 and conceded 1.1 a game between them.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
